output_list.reason: Integer overflow in mintToken function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function allows the owner to set the balance of the contract to zero, aka the 'tradeTrap' issue.
The sell function has an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set the balance of the contract to zero.
The mintToken function does not check the caller's identity, allowing unauthorized users to set the balance of the contract.
The buy function has an access control issue, allowing only the owner to set the balance of the contract.
The sell function has an access control issue, allowing only the owner to set the balance of the contract.
